Point_Coordinates.focus: Carry the existing black sphere and compare LOCAL with WORLD. Read what makes the body grabbable and how its position is expressed in each coordinate frame. The XR player setup is supplied; the pickable-body connection is part of this lesson. Distance calculation belongs in Point Lines.

Primitives_Godot.focus: Continue the carried PointBody sphere. While held, reduce its rings and radial segments in timed integer steps; release pauses, re-grab continues and reset restores. Stop at rings 1 and radial segments 4. Keep size, material and collider fixed; compare the two resolution settings separately. Carry a familiar object whose construction can change through interaction, on its way toward the catalyst.
